commit_clusters.6f106aaddab7: clang-builtins (CGBuiltin.cpp): review fix, f16altabs2 lowered as two opaque p.bclr

summary: Adds __builtin_pulp_f16abs (float16), f16altabs (float16alt), f16abs2 (v2h), f16altabs2 (v2ah) with GAP9 GCC's prototypes (own block at the end of BuiltinsRISCVXpulp.td). Lowered in EmitRISCVBuiltinExpr (CGBuiltin.cpp, own switch after the __builtin_shuffle dispatch): f16abs -> llvm.fabs.f16 (fabs.h, as GCC); f16abs2 -> bitcast to i32, AND 0x7fff7fff; f16altabs2 -> two llvm.riscv.pulp.bclr (bits 15 and 31, p.bclr x2); f16altabs -> llvm.riscv.pulp.bclr(zext, 0xffff7fff) = p.bclr bit 15. No new intrinsic, no back-end change. Deviation from the F016 pattern (intrinsic + ISel pattern) is deliberate: the results are illegal types (bf16, v2f16, v2bf16) on RV32, and the bf16 forms must not go through llvm.fabs because LLVM 20 soft-promotes a bf16 fabs via float + __truncsfbf2 (quiets sNaNs, symbol missing from GAP9 libgcc; fixed upstream by 11571a005a38, LLVM 22). A plain i16 AND is folded by InstCombine into llvm.fabs.bf16, and an AND on an extracted lane of the pair is narrowed and folded the same way (review), hence the opaque bclr intrinsic for both bf16 forms.

other_errors_seen: Pre-existing, general: in plain C, abs or negation of a float16alt (bf16) value, and even 'bits & 0x7fff' on one (InstCombine folds it into llvm.fabs.bf16), compiles to a __truncsfbf2 call (LLVM 20 SoftPromoteHalfRes_UnaryOp for FABS/FNEG). __truncsfbf2 is not in GAP9 libgcc (link error) and quiets signalling NaNs. Example: void neg(float16alt *p,int n){for(...) p[i]=-p[i];} with -march=rv32imc_xgap9 at int-20. Upstream fix 11571a005a38 'Fix legalizing FNEG and FABS with TypeSoftPromoteHalf (#156343)' (llvmorg-22.1.0); a backport would change upstream CHECK lines (llvm/test/CodeGen/RISCV/half-arith.ll changed in that commit), so it needs an owner decision / test-regen; or T3 makes bf16 a GPR register type. Suggest a BACKLOG row.

f16altabs (scalar) costs p.exthz+p.bclr(+p.bset for a returned value) where GCC uses one fabs.ah, and the pair forms lui+addi+and vs one vfabs.h/.ah; to switch to llvm.fabs and native instructions with T3/T5.
